source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 114, fielded September 13-18, 2022.
method: Population is Latter-day Saint respondents only (F_RELIG code 3, 190 unweighted). Each row is the share with a very or somewhat favorable view of that group (RELFAV_a-f, i) among Latter-day Saints who gave a rating; 'don't know enough to say' and refused are excluded from the denominator. Rows are the groups being rated, not the respondents' own religion. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W114 variable.
